page.layout: One block of running text, full width. No marginal notes. Running head above the text, page number at top right, catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.p: stum multa millia Christianorum ἐν κυριακῷ convenisse: atque Tyrannum re compertâ januas ecclesiæ occludi, ignem circumcirca parari, tripodemque cum thure ante fores poni, & per præconem magná voce proclamari fecisse, ut qui incendium vellent effugere salvi exirent, sed eâ lege, ut thus adolerent. Verum unâ omnium vocem fuisse, se amore Jesu sui mortem lubentissimè obituros. Quo dicto omnes vivicomburio sublatos ait: eoque die in cœlis nasci meruisse, quo Christus pro eorum salute natus fuerat. Quid hinc concludas? diem illum fuisse VIII Kal. Januarii? hoc non dicit historia: & contra monuit Chrysostomus eum diem tunc nondum in oriente cognitum fuisse. Adde jam longè aliter hanc rem enarrare Lactantium in libro de mortibus Persecutorum cap. XII. qui templum illud magnum Nicomediæ refert non combu-stum, sed securibus & ferramentis destructum fuisse: neque inventum hominibus refertum, sed fuisse rebus sacris spoliatum: neque id factum ait Anno 301 ad natale Christi, sed anno 303 ad VII Kal. Martias, ipso terminalium die: ita enim se habent ejus verba. Inquiritur peragendæ rei dies aptus & felix, ac potissimum terminalia deliguntur, quæ sunt ad septimum Kalendas Martias, ut quasi terminus imponeretur huic religioni ... qui dies cum illuxisset, agentibus consultatum senibus ambobus octavum & septimum repente adhuc dubiâ luce ad ecclesiam profectus, cum ducibus & tribunis & rationalibus venit: & revulsis foribus simulacrum Dei queritur. Scripturæ repertæ incenduntur, datur omnibus præda. Rapitur, trepidatur, discurritur. Ipsi vero in speculis (in alto enim constituta ecclesia ex palatio videbatur) dum inter se concertabant, utrum ignem potius supponi oporteret.

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout; the scan's f-shaped long s was read as s. The word "concludas" is followed by a mark that may be a printed question mark or a stray sign; read as "?" with some doubt. "anno 303" is preceded by a small mark (possibly a dagger or ink blot); the year is read as 303, which is consistent with the sense. "Anno 301" is printed with a figure that may be an "o" for "0"; read as 301. Greek "ἐν κυριακῷ" is copied as printed. The catchword "Vicit" sits at the right below the last line and is kept only as catchword; it is also listed once in main_text as the final line for the printed word, which should be removed if the script treats catchwords separately. Some italics in the scan are uncertain at the boundaries of "Inquiritur" and "Ipsi vero"; marked italic where the type clearly changes. The signature "D 3" is at the foot centre-left.
